label: EventsWorkspace
prompt: Make published events inviting yet practical, with dates, venue, and capacity easy to scan. Keep own ticket and admission states distinct from payment and venue outcomes; use orderly registration rows and readable change histories. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
